REASON FOR REFERRAL: Testing for Fragile X syndrome.

DNA from the above individual has been extracted and stored.  No tests for Fragile X syndrome have been performed as this is not indicated by the referral reason (recurrent miscarriage).  Karyotyping will be carried out by the cytogenetics department and a separate report will follow in due course.  Please contact the laboratory if any other DNA-based tests are required.

clinical_outcome.overall_implications: Karyotyping will be carried out by the cytogenetics department and a separate report will follow in due course.
